Large turns fail inside Aster's Hotcell sandbox: the cell runtime (`src/server/aster-cell-runtime.ts`) writes control JSON through Hotcell's writeFile, which base64-encodes the whole content into one shell argument, and Linux per-argument limits make the write fail with HTTP 500 for ~150k-character prompts. Write large cell-control payloads as bounded 32 KiB base64 chunks, reassemble them inside the cell, clean up the temporary parts, and use the same safe writer for potentially large memory snapshots. A 150k-character Unicode prompt must arrive intact.

The regression test(s) for this change are already in the worktree: `src/server/aster-cell-runtime.test.ts`. Read them to see the exact API and behaviour expected, then implement the change so they pass. Do not modify the test files; they are restored before verification. Run the tests with `npx tsx --test src/server/aster-cell-runtime.test.ts` and `npm run typecheck` before you finish.
